messages:
Alex: quick question — I need to look at redacted prod logs for tenant `tenant-42` to debug a spike. What's the minimal console/iam role we can grant at project/org level so I can search logs but not see PII? Prefer a 2h ephemeral grant if possible.
Maria: for basic viewing, `roles/logging.viewer` at the project scope usually works (lists/reads log entries). if logs are exported to BigQuery or GCS, you'll also need `bigquery.dataViewer` or `storage.objectViewer` on the export target.
Jamal: avoid org-level unless absolutely necessary. project-level `roles/logging.viewer` + the specific export role is least-priv. if you need to see log details that were redacted we should not grant anything that bypasses redaction.
Sophie: can we use the JIT tool for 2h? /access request -> sec-ops will auto-approve for on-call + owner ack. saves creating manual bindings.
Alex: sweet — I might need to query BQ since observability pipeline materializes logs there. what's the exact perm set we'd need to make a custom minimal role?
Maria: something like this (custom role perms):
```
logging.logEntries.list
logging.logEntries.get
logging.logs.list
bigquery.jobs.create   # to run queries
bigquery.readsessions.getData  # if using read sessions
stackdriver.projects.get  # general project read
```
Jamal: tweak: drop `logging.logs.list` if you only need to query known log names. keep `bigquery.jobs.create` scoped to the dataset. also consider adding `resourcemanager.projects.get` if the UI needs it.
Sophie: if you create a custom role, keep it at project scope and set allowed_duration = 2h in the access request. sec-ops will auto-approve for debugging requests from eng.
Alex: thanks. can someone paste a minimal gcloud example to create a temp binding or request?
Maria: for JIT via our internal tool: `/access request --role customDebugLogViewer --scope projects/my-prod --duration 2h --reason "investigate tenant-42 spike"`
Jamal: if you must create a direct binding (last resort):
```bash
# grant predefined logging viewer (project-level)
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding my-prod --member="user:alex@example.com" --role="roles/logging.viewer"
# remove after debugging
sleep 7200 && gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding my-prod --member="user:alex@example.com" --role="roles/logging.viewer"
```
Sophie: sec-bot: please note: JIT recommended, avoid manual bindings.
sec-bot: reminder — per policy SEC-401, manual temporary bindings require an audit ticket. use `/access request` for automatic logging + expiry.
Alex: perfect. I'll open the JIT request now and ping here when it's approved. thanks all :thumbsup:
Sophie: no prob — if you hit redaction blockers, DM me and we'll coordinate a sanitized pull or higher-level review.
Alex: will do.
